notes: The minifigure (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is not recorded.
The three orange cones (b1-b6) are real separate mini-builds on page 3 (each a cone on a 1x1 plate) and are not attached to the car, so they are deliberately left as three small separate groups.
The wrench (b7) is a loose tool; page 43 shows it fitting the wheel hub cover, so it is linked to b146 by a loose other_join only (not fastened).
The sticker sheet (b183) is one piece, joined to the pieces carrying stickers 1-9.
Earlier fixes kept: wedge plate b47 rests on bracket b37's studs; tile b40 is a side join; b138/b139 rest on studded pieces; pieces over stud-less curved bricks now rest on studded plates.
The parts list has 4x 24308a and 4x 24308b for four wheels, so each wheel is recorded with two stacked covers (assumption).
The booklet is only partly legible, so many rests_on relations are best-guess placements. Piece counts and colours match the parts list exactly (183 items).
Front wheels (b142-b151) pin into front brick b8; rear wheels (b152-b161) into brick b24.
